_comment: Business-line template: Custom Hiring Centre (farm machinery rental). SERVICE revenue model - capacity is annual machine-hours rented; there is no raw material -> product. Operators are shown as labour; 'Direct operating cost' = fuel + on-field consumables (~30% of revenue) entered as rm_costing_method=pct_of_revenue. Source: NABCONS AIF CHC model DPR, mapped to the 5-yr NIFTEM base.
report_title: DETAILED PROJECT REPORT - CUSTOM HIRING CENTRE

narrative.product_intro: A Custom Hiring Centre (CHC) is a set of farm machinery, implements and equipment owned by the FPO and rented out to member and neighbouring farmers on an hourly/per-acre basis, bringing mechanisation within reach of small and marginal holdings without each farmer having to own costly equipment.
narrative.raw_material_note: A CHC has no processed raw material; the main running inputs are diesel/fuel and on-field consumables, and the key resource is the pool of well-maintained machinery serving farms within a 5-7 km radius.
process_steps: Booking and scheduling of machinery by farmers
Dispatch of equipment and operator to the field
Field operation (tillage, sowing, threshing, harvesting, spraying)
Return, cleaning and routine maintenance of equipment
Metering of usage and rental billing
